pages.quiz:
CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #3
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: CREATIVE ARTS AND SPORTS
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Middle Distance Races and Montage: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Refuse all feedback on Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Middle Distance Races and Montage.
   D. Damage equipment used for Middle Distance Races and Montage.

2. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. The ticket price
   C. The speed of the music
   D. Only the volume

3. Best practice when working on Swimming: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Swimming.
   B. Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Swimming.
   D. Damage equipment used for Swimming.

4. Best practice when working on Components of Creative Arts and Sports: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   B. Damage equipment used for Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Components of Creative Arts and Sports.
   D. Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. Best practice when working on Drawing and Painting: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Drawing and Painting.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Drawing and Painting.
   C. Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   D. Damage equipment used for Drawing and Painting.

6. Best practice when working on Kenyan Indigenous Games: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   C. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Indigenous Games.
   D. Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. Best practice when working on Kenyan Folk Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Kenyan Folk Dance.
   B. Damage equipment used for Kenyan Folk Dance.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Kenyan Folk Dance.
   D. Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Brown, pink, and gold
   B. Black, white, and grey
   C. Green, orange, and purple
   D. Red, blue, and yellow

9. Best practice when working on Netball: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Netball.
   B. Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Netball.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Netball.

10. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Remove the need for rules
   B. Guarantee a trophy
   C. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   D. Replace drinking water

11. Best practice when working on Indigenous Kenyan Craft: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Indigenous Kenyan Craft.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Indigenous Kenyan Craft.

12. Best practice when working on Rhythm: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm.
   B. Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Rhythm.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Netball and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Fabric Decoration and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Descant Recorder and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Verse and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
pages.answers:
MARKING SCHEME
====

1. A — Practise Middle Distance Races and Montage with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

2. C — The speed of the music

3. B — Practise Swimming with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

4. D — Practise Components of Creative Arts and Sports with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

5. C — Practise Drawing and Painting with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

6. D — Practise Kenyan Indigenous Games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. D — Practise Kenyan Folk Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

8. D — Red, blue, and yellow

9. B — Practise Netball with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. C — Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk

11. A — Practise Indigenous Kenyan Craft with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

12. B — Practise Rhythm with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Netball; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

14. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Fabric Decoration; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

15. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Descant Recorder; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.

16. (4 marks)
Award marks for: (1) accurate definition/idea of Verse; (2) correct use of subject terms; (3) a relevant local example (home, school, market, farm, or community). Do not award for slogans with no content.
